exposure: Group NV: non-vaccinated pregnant women with no history of acute or previous Covid-19
Group 2D: pregnant women vaccinated with two doses of BNT162b2
Group 1D: pregnant women vaccinated with one dose of BNT162b2
outcome: safety of spinal anesthesia in pregnant women who underwent cesarean section
outcomes of spinal anesthesia in pregnant women who underwent cesarean section
cohort: 180 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section with spinal anesthesia
finding: The study found no significant differences in outcomes of spinal anesthesia between pregnant women who were vaccinated with the BNT162b2 vaccine and those who were not vaccinated.
